tool.name: OGS: computeSurfaceNodeIDsInPolygonalRegion
tool.description: Computes ids of mesh nodes that are in polygonal regions and resides on the top surface.
tool.command: ln -sf '$mesh_input_file' 'mesh_input_file.vtu'; ln -sf '$geo_file' 'geo_file.gml'; #if $gmsh_path ln -sf '$gmsh_path' 'gmsh_path.msh'; #end if computeSurfaceNodeIDsInPolygonalRegion --mesh-input-file 'mesh_input_file.vtu' --geo-file 'geo_file.gml' #if $gmsh_path --gmsh-path 'gmsh_path.msh' #end if

param.label: mesh input file
param.help: Input (.vtu). The name of the file containing the input mesh

param.label: geo file
param.help: Input (.gml). The name of the input file containing the polygons

param.label: gmsh path
param.help: Input (.msh). The path to the input binary file

tool.help: Computes ids of mesh nodes that are in polygonal regions and resides on the top surface. The polygonal regions have to be given in a gml- or gli-file. The found mesh nodes and the associated area are written as txt and csv data. The documentation is available at https://docs.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/model-preparation/computesurfacenodeidsinpolygonalregion.
